protocol.name: A2UI
protocol.note: Examples target the real A2UI protocol. Prior to phase-8 they used a local dialect that was never A2UI.

negative_fixtures.name: broken-circular
negative_fixtures.why: A cycle in the id-reference graph. JSON Schema cannot express acyclicity, so the normalizer enforces it.

negative_fixtures.name: broken-legacy-dialect
negative_fixtures.why: The pre-alignment local format. Retained so the dialect cannot creep back unnoticed — the corpus blind spot that hid TOOL_CALL_ARGS_DELTA for a whole phase.
